previous_autonomous_wave.result: Hardened genuine actor concurrency/cancellation and superseding Playback-token semantics so no stale operation can publish replacement authority; portable concurrency validation passed; PARITY not promoted.

latest_autonomous_wave.goal: Provide an integration-ready production dispatch adapter that coalesces rapid seek/loop/tempo controls before Playback token generation, routes every generated token through the correct coordinator path, and automatically restores authority after post-token failures.
latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: AW15 correctly fails closed when a newer token arrives during an in-flight operation, but rapid UI controls should not generate generations that are known to be obsolete. Also, Playback fence advancement can precede a backend throw, so a thrown token-producing method can hide an already-issued generation from DSP unless the integration layer reconstructs and recovers it.
latest_autonomous_wave.done_when: Superseded continuous intents consume no generation; actual token/coordinator work is globally serialized; tempo/recovery routing is explicit; invalid input and pending cancellation stay pre-token; post-token backend/coordinator failure triggers a newer automatic recovery token; failed recovery blocks further token generation until retry; stress/benchmark/evidence pass; device/audibility/PARITY claims remain disabled.
latest_autonomous_wave.result: COMPLETE_NON_PARITY: added Lane3ProductionIntentDispatcher with pre-token latest-wins coalescing for seek/loop/tempo, explicit token-route audit, globally serialized actual dispatch, cancellation boundaries, backend-failure token reconstruction from Playback fence snapshots, automatic recovery and recoveryBlocked/retry semantics. Portable validation: 500 seek burst -> 1 token/499 superseded; 300 mixed burst -> 3 tokens/297 superseded; 15000-intent stress -> 1500 tokens/13500 superseded; invalid/cancelled pending inputs consumed no token. Portable 20x2000 seek benchmark median 19.838ms, p95 24.113ms, max 25.193ms. Repository full-source self-test/benchmark authored. Xcode/device/current-Moises gates remain open; PARITY unchanged.
